data.convention:
[x] = [x delta_d] (homological, adelic; T_delta with delta U delta^-1 = U), delta_{d,l} = diag(1,d) at l | M, 1 elsewhere; on X_B(U_1(M p^s)) = primitive row vectors v = e_2 k^-1 mod M p^s mod phi(O^x) it acts by v -> d^{-1} v mod M, identity mod p^s.

_M := with d = p mod M, d = 1 mod p^s (lem:s01-Up(d)), i.e. v -> p^{-1} v mod M. Lean: diamondM with d := the unit of Z/(M p^s) with d = p mod M, 1 mod p^s, in the same one-prime diamond convention (right translation by diag(1,d)); exponent as in `sign`.
